cues: Polyploidy means more than two complete sets of chromosomes: triploid, tetraploid, hexaploid.
About half of all flowering plant species are polyploid.
In autopolyploidy the sets come from one species: A A becomes A A A A, as in the potato, and triploid banana and seedless watermelon.
